- Lay out your clothes the night before.
- Avoid checking your phone until after breakfast.

If a conversation turns hostile, politely excuse yourself and step away for a few minutes.
Set a firm bedtime for the kids and stick to the same routine every single night.
To build the habit, start small, reward yourself often, and never skip two days in a row.
When your child asks a hard question, stay calm, listen fully, and answer honestly.
